name: Relaunch Brightside
description: Relaunches this Brightside desktop process: starts a new instance of the same program, which unlocks and takes over from this one, and answers as soon as it has started — before the handover. Within seconds this process stops, so the work in flight here is cut off and resumes in the new one: a call cut off after this answer was cut off because the relaunch worked, so never relaunch again for that; brightside:info reports the new process id and start time. The new instance comes back as this one is (the window, or the tray); with no remembered passphrase it asks the owner for it, and this one runs on until then. Refused while Brightside is locked or a relaunch is already under way. To restart only the venue, brightside:restart is lighter. Venue-operator only.

accepted.description: True when the new instance was started.

pid.description: The operating-system process id of the new instance.
